content:
incident-bot: PAGER: High anomaly detected in billing.metering - token_count drift (+8%) vs baseline across us-west-2 emitters. AlertID: MB-20260317-9ab3. Symptoms: delayed emits, queue backlog, spike in charge flags. Runbook: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/metering-drift
oncall-anna: taking pager. pinging SRE.
matt.eng: on it. quick check, running aggregation query to compare emitted counts vs ledger snapshot...
```sql
SELECT hour, sum(emitted_tokens) as emitted, sum(ledger_tokens) as ledger
FROM metering.tokens_hourly
WHERE hour >= '2026-03-17T00:00:00Z'
GROUP BY hour
ORDER BY hour DESC
LIMIT 6;
```
sre-jess: looks like emitter-3 consumer stalled; redis queue backlog ~120k msgs. consumer retry rate spiked.
matt.eng: restarting consumer group for emitter-3 now: `kafka-consumer restart metering-consumer-3 --env prod`
infra-bot: action: restart job metering-consumer-3 initiated by matt.eng - job id restart-7065
infra-bot: restart completed successfully in 18s
matt.eng: restart succeeded. backlog decreasing but still elevated. current delta ~+5% vs baseline.
billing-ops: seeing ~14 customer overage flags in the last 30m, 3 with email alerts already sent. pausing automatic overage notifications.
pm-alex: what's the customer impact surface? do we need an external status update?
cust-support-lara: pulling list of affected customers now, will notify top 5 directly. 2 customers already opened tickets re false overage.
sre-jess: recommend reprocess from emitter backups into billing pipeline in shadow first. planned window: 2026-03-17T00:00Z -> 2026-03-17T04:00Z. kick off reprocess job in ~5m. command: `billing.reprocess(window='2026-03-17T00:00Z/2026-03-17T04:00Z', mode='shadow')`
oncall-anna: flipping system flag to disable auto overage triggers: `curl -s -XPOST https://internal.api/billing/flags -H 'Authorization: Bearer <token>' -d '{"auto_overage": false}'`
billing-ops: confirmed auto_overage disabled. invoice runs paused for affected window.
matt.eng: reprocess job rp-3301 kicked off. monitoring logs... latest: `Handled 98% of delayed messages, remaining ~3.2k`
cust-support-lara: got first customer reply - they saw an overage email and are on Hold. Provided temporary credit guidance and ETA 1-2 hours.
pm-alex: if reprocess reconciles counts, we'll issue credits for false positives. billing-ops to prepare batch.
billing-ops: recommend pro-rated credit policy. will prepare draft and run through finance approval. tagging #billing-postmortem
sre-jess: preliminary root cause: consumer GC pause + connector backpressure under a small memory allocation. capturing heap dump and metrics. will open PR to bump consumer JVM mem and add backpressure alerts (emit latency > 2s).
incident-bot: INCIDENT UPDATE: Mitigation in progress. Customers affected: ~14 flagged, ~3 emailed. auto_overage paused. Reprocess rp-3301 running. Next update in 30m or at resolution. :white_check_mark:
oncall-anna: handing off active monitoring to matt.eng and billing-ops. I'll join handoff with oncall-bob at +30m.
matt.eng: taking post-mitigation lead, will post progress and final closure. closing channel for synchronous ops, leave thread for async updates. :eyes:
